purpose: A NULL receiver skips unknown-name CV reception and a spread producer. A nonnull selected Generator survives producer retirement; its copied ALIAS value and sole receiver cleanup preserve ordinary finally/weak lifetime order.
source:
<?php
class Token110P { function __destruct() { echo 'TOKEN|'; } }
function warning110P($severity, $message) { echo 'BAD-WARN|'; return true; }
function noise110P() { echo 'BAD-PRODUCER|'; return []; }
function stream110P() {
    global $cell, $weakToken, $weakGenerator;
    try {
        echo 'INIT|', $weakGenerator->get() instanceof Generator, '|';
        $received = yield 'head';
        $cell = 41;
        echo 'GOT|', $received === $weakToken->get(), '|', $cell === 41, '|', $weakGenerator->get() instanceof Generator, '|';
        yield 'tail';
        echo 'BAD-RESUME|';
    } finally {
        echo 'FIN|', $weakGenerator->get() instanceof Generator, '|', $weakToken->get() instanceof Token110P, '|', $cell === 41, '|';
    }
}
function pack110P() {
    global $generator, $pack;
    echo 'PACK|'; $saved = $pack; $generator = null; $pack = null; return $saved;
}
$generator = null; set_error_handler('warning110P');
$nullResult = $generator?->send(unknown: $missing);
echo 'NULL-NAME|', $nullResult === null, '|';
$nullResult = $generator?->throw(...noise110P());
echo 'NULL-PACK|', $nullResult === null, '|';
restore_error_handler();
$cell = new Token110P(); $weakToken = WeakReference::create($cell);
$pack = ['value' => &$cell];
$generator = stream110P(); $weakGenerator = WeakReference::create($generator);
echo 'CALL|'; $result = $generator?->send(...pack110P());
echo 'RETURN|', $result === 'tail', '|', $generator === null, '|', $pack === null, '|', $weakGenerator->get() === null, '|', $weakToken->get() === null, '|', $cell === 41, '|';

purpose: An ignored nullsafe current call on a temporary receiver releases its returned cache copy before Generator storage. The cached Token destructor sees the real Generator weak-live, then the caller sees it dead.
source:
<?php
class Token110D {
    function __destruct() { global $weakGenerator; echo 'TOKEN|', $weakGenerator->get() === null, '|'; }
}
function stream110D() { try { yield new Token110D(); } finally { echo 'FIN|'; } }
function make110D() { global $weakGenerator; $generator = stream110D(); $weakGenerator = WeakReference::create($generator); return $generator; }
echo 'CURRENT|'; make110D()?->current(); echo 'AFTER|', $weakGenerator->get() === null, '|';

purpose: A used owning nullsafe CURRENT result survives Generator retirement and dies only when the caller unsets it; its destructor weak-sees the Generator already dead.
